# ECHO GitHub labels

Use with `gh label create`. Each issue must have:

- exactly one `status:*`
- at least one `maturity:*`
- at least one `type:*`
- exactly one `priority:*`
- optional `runtime:*` and `risk:*`

This mapping follows Allsparks `status:*` / `type:*` / `epic` practice (TRACE, HELM, AMPER) and adds the maturity/priority sets required for ECHO so issues cannot imply competition approval by existing.
